subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core's durable memory source of truth move from Markdown files to a plugin-owned typed SQLite record model for the MVP, and what migration, provenance, and review contract must ship with it?
rationale: The issue changes durable memory product semantics, storage ownership, upgrade behavior, and sibling Memory MVP work, so automation cannot safely choose the model alone.

options.title: Approve SQLite MVP Model
options.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement schema and migrations in the memory plugin boundary.

options.title: Keep Markdown Canonical
options.body: Narrow or close this schema effort and continue treating SQLite as retrieval/index infrastructure around Markdown durable memory.

options.title: Defer Memory Convergence
options.body: Keep this as design backlog until maintainers choose the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve SQLite MVP Model
recommendation.body: Define the v1 record/status/revision/provenance contract first, then implement schema and migrations in the memory plugin boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product/storage direction, and steipete has the strongest product-routing signal among the related memory boundary contributors.
